article.articleHeadline: Casos e mortes por dengue no RS caem 97% entre janeiro e abril - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases and deaths in Rio Grande do Sul fall 97% between January and April - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, fell 97.1% from Jan 1 to May 8, 2026, with 994 confirmed cases and 1 death versus 35,433 cases and 32 deaths in the same period of 2025. Authorities attribute reductions to ongoing Aedes aegypti control by the State Health Surveillance Center (CEVS), favorable climate, and expanded vaccination. Prevention highlights include ovitrampas (egg traps) in 342 of 497 municipalities (~70%), down from 238 in Jan–Apr 2025; residual indoor spraying (BRI) used in 224 municipalities (45%), up from 119 in early 2025 (223 in 2026). Winter 2025 was harsher than 2022–2024, and a drier spring reduced breeding sites heading into 2026; El Niño could raise dengue risk in 2027. Vaccination with Qdenga (Takeda) began in 2026, later complemented by Butantan-DV; initial doses to health workers, with general vaccination proceeding in descending age order from 59 to 15 years, while targeting 10–14-year-olds in priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・リオグランデ・ド・スル州のデング熱患者と死亡が1月～4月で97%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の大幅な減少を報告する良好な進行状況のニュースであり、異常性や予想外性、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は認められない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年1月～5月8日にかけてリオグランデ・ド・スル州でデング熱が前年同期比97.1%減少したことを報告している。死亡者も32人から1人に低下。これは疾病監視の成功を示すニュースであり、新興感染症の脅威や拡大傾向を示すシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirüs + Andes virüsü enfeksiyonları nereye gidiyor: Pandemi yapar mı?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where are hantavirus and Andes virus infections headed: Will they become a pandemic?
article.articleSummary: WHO is monitoring hantavirus infections linked to an Atlantic Ocean cruise ship; no cases in the Eastern Mediterranean region. Hantaviruses cause two syndromes: HFRS (hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome) in Europe–Asia (mortality 1–15%), and HPS/HCPS by Andes virus in the Americas (mortality 35–50%). Affected countries include Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Brazil, and Patagonia; the reservoir is the pygmy rice rat (Oligoryzomys longicaudatus). Transmission occurs via rodent urine, droppings, or saliva; Andes virus can spread between humans. Incubation 7–39 days (avg ~14). Early symptoms: fever 38–40 C, myalgia, headache, nausea for 3–6 days; later pulmonary edema, dyspnea, cough, hypotension, shock with rapid decline in 24–48 hours. Diagnosis by PCR and IgM/IgG ELISA; testing in Turkey at Refik Saydam. No human vaccine; Ribavirin may help HFRS. Andes not yet reported in Turkey; Epuyén outbreak (2018–2019): 34 cases, 11 deaths. Pandemic potential is low (R0<1). Prevention: avoid rodent exposure, use N95, bleach for cleanup, and isolate suspected Andes cases.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとアンデスウイルス感染症はどこへ向かうのか：パンデミックになるか？
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症（特にアンデスウイルス）は高い致死率（35-50%）を示し、複数国で報告されているが、記事では「パンデミックのリスクは低い（R0<1）」と明記されており、現在の状況では国際的蔓延のリスクは限定的。情報不足により確定的な判断が困難なため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotが報告した地域にはスペイン（カナリア諸島）、ギリシャ、トルコ、米国アリゾナなどが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はアンデスウイルス感染症であり、実際の発生国はアルゼンチン、チリ、ウルグアイ、ブラジルなど南米に限定されている。対象国リストに該当するのはBrazilのみ。航海船での感染報告があるが具体的な国籍や乗客の所属国が不明。パンデミック化のリスクは記事で「低い」と評価されている点が注目。

article.articleHeadline: Thai virologist says hantavirus risk in Thailand remains very low - Pattaya Mail
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus risk in Thailand remains very low, says Prof Dr Yong Poovorawan, head of the Center of Excellence in Clinical Virology at Chulalongkorn University. Thai hantavirus strains differ from the Andes strain attracting international attention in South America; the virus has existed in Thailand for 40–50 years with prior infections and antibodies detected in both rodents and humans. Hantavirus is an RNA virus carried by rodents and is typically transmitted to humans by inhaling dust contaminated with rodent urine, saliva, or feces. Symptoms can include fever, muscle pain, headaches, nausea, and vomiting, with potential kidney failure, hemorrhaging, pulmonary edema, and respiratory failure in severe cases. Person-to-person transmission is considered rare except for the Andes strain. In Thailand, hantavirus or related genetic material has been identified in rodents such as field rats and bandicoot rats; antibodies have been found in people with rodent exposure or agricultural work. Human cases remain extremely rare; there is no reason for excessive public concern.

triage.headline_ja: タイのウイルス学者、タイでのハンタウイルスリスクは非常に低いままだと述べる - パタヤメール
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスはタイに40～50年間存在し、人間への感染は極めてまれであり、専門家が公開的にリスクは非常に低いと評価している。国際的な拡大リスクや異常事象ではなく、むしろ安心情報の発信である。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンタウイルスの既知リスク状況に関する専門家による安心情報の発信であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクを示すシグナルではない。南米のAndes株とタイの株は異なり、タイでの感染は極めてまれであることが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes DIY Pastikan Suspek Hantavirus Kulonprogo Negatif, Warga Diimbau PHBS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DIY Health Office Confirms Kulon Progo Hantavirus Suspect Is Negative, Residents Urged to Practice PHBS.
article.articleSummary: Kulon Progo Regency, Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, reports no human hantavirus case after laboratory tests by the Ministry of Health; a suspected hantavirus case tested negative and the results were released two days before May 11, 2026. Health officials from Kulonprogo District and DIY Health Office confirmed there is no positive hantavirus infection in the area. Rodents and other small mammals are the primary transmitters of hantavirus; the public is urged to maintain clean living practices (PHBS) and environmental hygiene to reduce rodent presence and exposure. Recommendations include washing hands with soap after farm work or community clean-up activities and preventing rodent entry into homes. No imported/exported case details are reported.

triage.headline_ja: DIY保健局がクロンプロゴのハンタウイルス疑い患者は陰性と確認、住民に個人衛生習慣(PHBS)の実践を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス疑い患者の検査が陰性であり、確認患者がない。地域の懸念は衛生啓発レベルで、国際的拡大の兆候やIHR基準該当なし。
triage.notes: 疑い患者の検査が陰性で、実際の患者発生がない状況。記事は公衆衛生啓発・予防措置の呼びかけが主題。ハンタウイルスは流行性疾患だが、この事象は一般的な感染症流行の警告ではなく、単一の陰性検査結果の報告である。シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra cerca de 40 casos de hantavirose por ano, revela ministério
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records about 40 hantavirus cases per year, ministry reveals.
article.articleSummary: Brazil records hantavirus disease; Minas Gerais reports one death in Uberlândia (Triângulo Mineiro). Brazil has 12 cases this year; average is about 40 per year. Over 2016–2026, cases range 30–50 annually, with a case fatality around 40%, commonly HCPS. Most notifications come from the South, Southeast, and Central-West; Paraná, Santa Catarina, Mato Grosso and Minas Gerais lead due to agricultural activity fostering rodent contact. Minas Gerais has 33 deaths in the last decade. The MG case involves a rural worker with fever, myalgia, and respiratory failure, linked to a grain-storage facility where wild rodents shelter. Transmission occurs via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent excreta; contact with excreta also possible. No vaccine exists; control relies on hygiene and environmental management. Seven diagnoses by March 30 across MG, RS, SC, and PR; the ship outbreak is unrelated.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルは年間約40件のハンタウイルス感染症（ハンタウイルス肺症候群）の症例を記録、保健省が明かす
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症によるブラジルでの死亡例が報告され、約40%の致死率を示す既知の風土病パターンが確認されている。過去10年間でミナスジェライス州だけで33人の死亡があり、農業活動に関連した人口感染のリスク要因が存在するため、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルス感染症はブラジルにおいて既知の風土病であり、年間40例程度の定常的発生があるが、約40%の高い致死率と農業活動に関連した継続的な曝露リスク、複数州への広がりがWPRO基準の3項目を満たす。IHR基準は国際的拡大リスクが明確でないため2未満だが、重症度と継続的リスク要因によりPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Indian crew members aboard hantavirus-hit MV Hondius are 'asymptomatic and healthy,' embassy confirms
article.articleSummary: Andes hantavirus outbreak aboard the Dutch expedition vessel MV Hondius off Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain, has eight probable cases and three deaths among about 150 people from 23 countries. WHO and ECDC classify all on board as high-risk contacts; repatriation flights underway. Two Indian crew members are healthy and asymptomatic, evacuated to the Netherlands for quarantine per international health safety protocols; the Indian Embassy confirms they will be monitored. The ship arrived at Granadilla, Tenerife after being held off Cape Verde, prompting a global health response. The Andes virus can spread human-to-human in rare circumstances; the ECDC recommends up to 42 days of monitoring for contacts due to incubation. Indian health officials say infections among Indian nationals are isolated imports with low public health risk; hantavirus is primarily rodent-borne. National agencies NCDC and IDSP are monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染のMV Hondius号に乗船していたインド人乗組員は「無症状で健康」と大使館が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク）、複数国での患者発生、死亡例あり、WHO/ECDC関与の国際的対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはスペイン、カーボベルデ、オランダ、インドが列挙されているが、記事サマリー上で実際の感染イベントはスペイン領カナリア諸島の船舶上で発生。インド人乗組員については患者ではなく無症状接触者として言及されており、インドは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。スペイン、オランダ、カーボベルデは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当するシグナルとしてのハイリスク事案。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina confirma caso de hantavírus, mas garante que cepa é diferente do cruzeiro - Jornal Razão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina confirms a hantavirus case, but assures that the strain is different from Cruzeiro - Jornal Razão.
article.articleSummary: Santa Catarina confirms a hantavirus case in Seara, in the western part of the state, the first in 2026. The local strain is not the same as the Andes hantavirus variant linked to the MV Hondius cruise outbreak, which has demonstrated human-to-human transmission. The Santa Catarina lineage transmits mainly via contact with urine, feces, or saliva of infected rodents, through inhalation of contaminated dust. Since 2020–2026, the state has recorded 92 hantavirus cases (2023: 26; 2024: 11; 2025: 15); samples are sent to Lacen for diagnostic confirmation, with active surveillance ongoing. Internationally, the MV Hondius outbreak involves the Andes hantavirus variant capable of human transmission, with three confirmed deaths (a Dutch couple and a German woman); the ship departed Ushuaia on April 1 and carried 88 passengers and 59 crew from 23 nationalities. Common early symptoms include fever, body pains, malaise, nausea, and abdominal pain; severe cases may progress to pulmonary failure.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州がハンタウイルス患者を確認、ただし株はクルゼイロ由来の株とは異なると保証
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症（Andes型）の国際的な舶船アウトブレイク関連で、複数国境を超えた伝播リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染能を有する株、死亡例報告（3例）があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Andes型ハンタウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染が可能であり、MV Hondius船舶でのアウトブレイク（3死亡、23国籍の乗客乗員）と関連。サンタカタリーナ州での確認患者は別系統だが、国際的なハンタウイルス発生警戒が高まっている状況。アルゼンチン（Tierra del Fuego、Ushuaia）も発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジル（サンタカタリーナ州Seara）の患者確認であり、アルゼンチンは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm não Nhật Bản: Cẩn trọng dấu hiệu dễ nhầm với sốt siêu vi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japanese Encephalitis: Beware signs that can be easily mistaken for a viral fever.
article.articleSummary: Japanese Encephalitis (JEV) is a mosquito-borne viral disease in Vietnam, circulated by Culex mosquitoes in rural areas with pigs and poultry, but increasingly reported in urban and highland settings. Early symptoms in children resemble common viral fever: fever, headache, and vomiting, but progression to confusion, seizures, or coma signals severe disease requiring urgent care. Diagnosis combines clinical assessment with blood tests, CSF analysis, and imaging when needed. There is no specific antiviral; treatment is supportive, focusing on brain protection and managing complications. Vaccination is crucial. JEV vaccines exist, some in the national immunization program and some private. Complete the schedule and boosters to maintain immunity; missing doses raises risk. If vaccination history is unclear, consult the national registry and obtain appropriate catch-up doses. Preventive measures include bed nets, long clothing, environmental hygiene, and eliminating standing water near homes and farms. Seek prompt hospital evaluation for fever with altered consciousness.

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎：ウイルス性熱と間違えやすい兆候に注意
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎はベトナムで認識されている既知の風土病であり、本記事は予防啓発を目的とした教育的記事。新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、または重大な新展開の報告がなく、シグナルとしての緊急性は限定的だが、公衆衛生上の重要性と地域的関心により継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は日本脳炎の既知の風土病としての啓発的内容。ベトナムではCulex蚊による循環が農村部で確認されており、都市部・高地での報告増加が言及されているが、急速な拡大やアウトブレイク状況を示す具体的指標（症例数増加、致死率上昇など）の記載はない。ワクチン接種推奨と予防措置の強調から、既知リスクの管理に焦点が当たっている。フルRRAは不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 'स्वस्थ और सुरक्षित': हंता वायरस प्रभावित क्रूज से निकाले गए भारतीय क्रू सदस्य, दूतावास का बयान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Healthy and Safe': Indian crew members evacuated from hantavirus-affected cruise, says the embassy.
article.articleSummary: Two Indian crew members on the Dutch cruise MV Hondius, held near the Canary Islands after hantavirus exposure, have been evacuated to the Netherlands and placed in quarantine. They are asymptomatic. Spain’s Indian Embassy said both are healthy with no symptoms, and will remain quarantined in the Netherlands under CENEM guidance. About 150 people aboard were near the Canary Islands when hantavirus was detected; the ship then reached Spain and all passengers and crew were disembarked under health safeguards. The WHO issued a technical note urging rapid identification, monitoring, and management of contacts linked to MV Hondius. WHO notes Andes virus can transmit between humans only rarely, typically with close contact. As of May 8, eight hantavirus cases have been reported, including three deaths, with six confirmed Andes virus infections. Indian experts say these are imported cases and do not indicate community transmission in India.

triage.headline_ja: '健康で安全': ハンタウイルス感染のクルーズ船から避難したインド人乗組員、大使館声明
triage.triage_reason: インドからの事例報告だが、実際の感染地はカナリア諸島・スペイン・オランダであり、インド国内での感染拡大なし。情報が限定的で、さらなる展開を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカナリア諸島（スペイン）での船上でのハンタウイルス検出イベントであるが、インド人乗組員の避難と隔離がニュースの焦点。インド国内での社会的関心は高いが、インド国内では感染拡大はなく「輸入症例」と評価。IHR基準では2件該当（異常性・国際的拡大）するが、実質的なリスク評価には情報不足。スペイン・オランダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations はインドのみ。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: '한타 감염' 크루즈선 승객들 귀국 개시...WHO 의료 감시 권고 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus infection: Cruise ship passengers begin returning home... WHO recommends medical surveillance.
article.articleSummary: An Atlantic-hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius has led to passenger disembarkation in Tenerife, Canary Islands. WHO recommends 42 days of medical surveillance for all passengers, while pandemic risk remains low. By arrival at Granadilla, 94 passengers from 19 countries had disembarked; 14 Spaniards reached Torrejon de Ardoz air base near Madrid; 18 headed to the United States were transported to University of Nebraska Medical Center for 42 days of surveillance. Five French passengers included one symptomatic on the return flight. Twenty British passengers and 3 crew were moved to Merseyside Hospital for medical surveillance, later staying at home. Philippine cruise-hotel staff were isolated in the Netherlands. Singapore quarantined 2 residents with Hondius exposure at NCID. The ship had departed Ushuaia, Argentina on April 1; an Andes virus variant capable of human-to-human transmission is suspected. Initial infection likely pre-departure; global pandemic threat not indicated.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染：クルーズ船乗客が帰国開始...WHOが医療監視を勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性、重症度、流行可能性が確認される。複数国での同時展開と人間-人間感染の可能性があるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供する発生地域には対象国外の多数の地点（スペイン、アルゼンチン、米国、フランス、英国、オランダ、シンガポール）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベントはクルーズ船（MV Hondius）での集団感染であり、対象国リストでは Philippines のみに該当。ハンタウイルスの人間-人間感染能（Andes virus variant）が疑われる点は公衆衛生上の懸念となる。WHOによる42日間の医療監視勧告、複数国への患者分散、および高リスク国への輸送は国際的管理の必要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി ബാധിച്ച് മയിലുകൾ കൂട്ടത്തോടെ ചത്തു | Peacocks die en masse due to bird flu | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peacocks die en masse due to avian influenza
article.articleSummary: On May 11, 2026, in Tumakuru district, Karnataka, India, avian influenza was confirmed in dead peafowl, as authorities reported rising mortality among peacocks in the district. Within a month, 54 peafowl deaths were recorded across Tumakuru's taluks, with an initial count of 44; subsequent days saw the tally rise. After Kunigal taluk detected symptomatic birds, indicators suggested the virus may be spreading to other parts of the district. In Bommanahalli, a poultry farm experienced the mass death of more than 30 chickens; however, laboratory tests on chicken samples were negative for avian influenza. The Department of Animal Husbandry and the Wildlife/Forestry department intensified surveillance, deploying special teams to monitor avian movement district-wide. The public is urged to report dead birds or wildlife promptly and collect samples from affected areas such as Rikunigal for laboratory testing.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザによるクジャクの大量死 | 鳥インフルエンザにより孔雀が大量に死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのカルナータカ州ツマクル地区で鳥インフルエンザがクジャクで確認され、1ヶ月間で54羽の死亡が記録されている。IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度（多数の野生動物死亡）、長期曝露（継続中の監視体制）、流行しやすさ（ウイルス拡大の可能性）が該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、ツマクル地区（カルナータカ州、インド）で野生のクジャク（孔雀）での鳥インフルエンザ感染が確認されており、1ヶ月で54羽の死亡が報告されている。同地区のボンマナハリ養鶏場では30羽以上の鶏が死亡したが、検査結果は陰性。ウイルス拡大の可能性が示唆されており、当局は監視態勢を強化している。人獣共通感染症としての鳥インフルエンザの公衆衛生上の懸念は国際的に重要である。

article.articleHeadline: 하노이, 한타바이러스 예방 위해 입국객 건강 상태 밀착 감시
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi closely monitors the health of incoming travelers to prevent hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi strengthens hantavirus surveillance and prevention under the Department of Disease Prevention’s guidelines, with the Hanoi Department of Health directing intensified measures. The city’s health authority instructs the Hanoi CDC to continuously update the global infectious disease situation and maintain close monitoring. Incoming and transfer passengers at Noi Bai International Airport will be screened to promptly identify confirmed or suspected hantavirus cases and to isolate and manage them at screening sites. The Hanoi Department of Health also requires city public and private hospitals to establish readiness for patient arrivals, aiming to minimize severe illness and deaths through admission, early diagnosis, isolation, and access to intensive care, while enforcing infection-prevention measures for patients and guardians. It also mandates capacity-building training for healthcare workers on hantavirus diagnosis, nursing, treatment, emergency care, and intensive-care resuscitation guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、ハンタウイルス予防のため入国旅客の健康状態を厳密に監視
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の予防強化と監視体制の構築が報告されているが、現在のところ確認患者や具体的な発生数の記載がなく、実際の感染症危機の段階は不明。引き続き患者報告や流行状況の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的措置と監視体制の強化について報告しており、現在のところ確認患者や死亡例の報告は明記されていない。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介で流行しやすい病原体であるが、具体的なケース数や重症度情報がないため詳細な評価は困難。今後の患者報告や地域での流行状況の続報を注視することが重要。

article.articleHeadline: "ดีอี" ตรวจสอบแล้วข่าวจริง "พบเชื้อไวรัสโคโรนาสายพันธุ์ใหม่ในตัวค้างคาวไทย" | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'DE' verified real news 'A novel coronavirus found in bats in Thailand' | Daily News
article.articleSummary: On 9 May 2026, Thailand confirmed a real news item: a novel coronavirus detected in bats in Thailand. The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (DE) and AFNC reported that the finding is part of a One Health surveillance program coordinated with the Department of Disease Control and the Ministry of Public Health. Of 160,397 monitored messages, 8,714 required verification; 24 items were escalated for review, with 11 results received and published. The top public-interest item is the true report of a novel coronavirus in Thai bats; currently no human infections have been detected. Studies indicate the virus has disease-causing potential and lower transmissibility than SARS-CoV-2, and vaccines for COVID-19 remain effective at reducing disease severity. Officials urge the public to share only information from official sources and to verify facts to counter misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 「DE」が確認した本当のニュース「タイの蝙蝠で新型コロナウイルスを発見」| デイリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: タイでの新規コロナウイルス株の動物での検出は異常・予想外であり、One Health監視プログラムの一部として報告されている。ただし現時点で人間への感染例はなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 動物における新規ウイルス株の発見は感染症サーベイランスの観点で注視対象。現在のところ人間への感染はなく、ワクチン有効性も確認されている。今後の人間感染例の出現が重要な監視ポイント。

locations.name: Saint Helena, Ascension, and Tristan da Cunha

article.articleHeadline: ഹന്താവൈറസ്: രണ്ട് ഇന്ത്യൻ പൗരന്മാരെ നെതർലൻഡ്സിലേക്ക് മാറ്റി | 2 Indians aboard cruise ship with hantavirus cases evacuated to Netherlands | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Two Indian nationals evacuated to the Netherlands
article.articleSummary: Two Indian nationals aboard the Dutch expedition cruise MV Hondius were evacuated to the Netherlands after hantavirus infections were reported on the ship. The travellers are asymptomatic, and the Indian Embassy in Madrid said they would be quarantined there. Oceanwide Expeditions’ ship departed Ushuaia, Argentina on April 1 and anchored at the Canary Islands after the outbreak was detected. The vessel carries about 147 people from 23 countries; 59 crew are aboard. Three deaths have been linked to hantavirus aboard—the Dutch woman, her husband, and a German traveler—while five infections have been laboratory-confirmed by the WHO. Over 140 occupants remain asymptomatic on board, with strict controls and an incubation window of 1–8 weeks. On April 24, 29 passengers disembarked at Saint Helena; authorities are tracing and monitoring them as imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：2人のインド国籍者がオランダに避難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国にまたがるクルーズ船での集団感染で、死亡者3名、確認患者5名、かつ長期潜伏期間による継続的リスク。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから付与された発生地域はスペイン（Madrid、Canary Islands）、アルゼンチン（Tierra del Fuego、Ushuaia）、オランダ、セントヘレナなど多数記載されているが、対象国リストのうち実際のイベント発生に関連するのはインドのみ。クルーズ船は多国籍乗客を乗せており、Saint Helenaで29名が下船し、継続的な監視が行われている。インド国籍者の避難という外交的側面も含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Asyik Lari Pagi, Warga Camba Tiba-tiba Digigit Anjing Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: While Enjoying a Morning Run, Camba Residents Were Suddenly Bitten by a Rabid Dog.
article.articleSummary: On May 7, 2026, in Pattiro Deceng Village, Camba District, Maros Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, 29-year-old Gufran was bitten by a brown rabid dog while jogging at 06:00 WITA, having run about 3.5 km. The incident is described as a rabies bite; no information is provided on medical treatment, laboratory confirmation, or outcomes. The report, published by Tribun-Timur on May 11, 2026, notes the event as an isolated case and highlights the ongoing rabies risk in the region, with no additional cases or deaths mentioned. Location details: Desa Pattiro Deceng, Kecamatan Camba, Kabupaten Maros, Sulawesi Selatan. The summary reflects a single incident without broader outbreak data.

triage.headline_ja: 朝ジョギングを楽しんでいたカンバ住民が突然狂犬病犬に噛まれた
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発的な狂犬病咬傷事例であり、アウトブレイクの兆候がない。IHR基準は該当せず、WPRO基準の「流行しやすさ」のみ若干該当するが、重症度・国際拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響がなく、シグナルとしての閾値に達しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・南スラウェシ州マロス県カンバ地区の単一の散発的咬傷事例を報道。実験室確認や治療結果の情報なし。地域の狂犬病リスクは存在するが、アウトブレイクの兆候はなく、スペイン（ガリシア州）はBluedot APIにより誤って付与された可能性があり、記事サマリーに基づき除外。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: Border screening in place amid hantavirus concerns
article.articleSummary: Border screening in the Philippines is in place to prevent hantavirus entry, as of 2026-05-11, after reports that 38 Filipino crew members were among the personnel aboard MV Hondius, a cruise ship linked to a hantavirus outbreak. The DOH, with the Bureau of Quarantine (BOQ) and the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (RITM), is consulting with the World Health Organization and other countries to monitor the hantavirus infection from MV Hondius. Border screening is ready for all passengers and vessels to prevent spread. No hantavirus cases have been recorded in the Philippines to date. Agencies emphasize ongoing surveillance, rapid case detection, and international coordination to limit importation and domestic transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DOH: ハンタウイルス懸念の中、国境スクリーニング実施中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。国際的なクルーズ船での集団発生に関連し、フィリピンが国境スクリーニングを導入した重要なイベント。
triage.notes: MV Hondiusはクルーズ船で複数国の乗客・乗員が関係しており、国際的な感染症対応が既に進行中。フィリピン国内では未確認だが、予防的な国境スクリーニングと WHO との連携が実施されており、公衆衛生対応の実例として重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Valley Fever? Indian Techie In US Dies After Battling Rare Virus Infection
article.articleSummary: One fatal Valley fever case in California is reported. A 37-year-old Indian tech professional, Chiranjeevi Kolla, died on May 5, 2026, after a month-long battle with Valley fever. He had first developed flu-like symptoms in April and was initially treated for severe pneumonia before tests confirmed infection with Coccidioides, the fungus in soil of the southwestern United States. Valley fever, usually affecting the lungs, spreads via inhaled airborne spores released when soil is disturbed by wind, farming, or construction. Kolla was intubated and placed on a ventilator for about 30 days in hospital. He leaves behind wife Pavani Marella and five-year-old son Vihan; a GoFundMe fundraiser notes he was the family’s emotional and financial backbone, with medical, mortgage, and funeral costs in California and India. Symptoms include fever, cough, chest pain, fatigue, shortness of breath, headache, muscle or joint pain; disseminated disease is rare.

triage.headline_ja: Valley Fever（コクシジオイデス症）とは何か？インドの技術者が米国で稀なウイルス感染との闘病後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: コクシジオイデス症による死亡事例は個別ケースであり、IHR基準やWPRO基準での複数該当が不明確。情報は限定的だが、米国の風土病であり国際的な公衆衛生懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はカリフォルニアの個別死亡事例であり、インド国内での発症・流行ではない。発生地域にIndiaが含まれているが、サマリーではインド系の被害者がいるのみで、実際のイベント発生地はカリフォルニア（米国）に限定される。対象国のリストに米国は含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。コクシジオイデス症は米国南西部の風土病であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。死亡例による社会的関心は存在するが、感染症の公衆衛生上のリスクは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 500 Anjing di Camba Bakal Divaksin, Setelah 8 Warga Digigit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 500 Dogs in Camba to Be Vaccinated, After Eight Residents Were Bitten
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak prompts vaccination drive in Camba District, Maros Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia. Eight residents were bitten by dogs confirmed positive for rabies, triggering a vaccination campaign for 500 dogs. Veterinary public health teams from the Department of Agriculture and Food Security and the Balai Besar Veteriner (BBV) Maros were deployed to vaccinate dogs across Cenrana, Sawaru, Timpuseng, and Pattiro Deceng villages. Beginning Saturday, May 9, 2026, health workers set up vaccination points as residents arrived with their pets. The operation aims to curb rabies transmission and protect local residents, with authorities coordinating the response in the wake of the bites; the article was published on May 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: カンバ地区の500頭の犬がワクチン接種予定、8人の住民が咬傷被害後
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スラウェシ州で確認された狂犬病発生であり、8人の咬傷被害と複数村での疫学的広がりが確認されている。スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）を複数満たし、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 南スラウェシ州マロス県カンバ地区での狂犬病アウトブレイク。8人の咬傷被害、複数の村での拡大を示唆。当局が組織的なワクチン接種キャンペーンを展開中。

article.articleHeadline: North Korea Flags Hantavirus Danger in Cruise Ship Outbreak
article.articleSummary: North Korea’s Rodong Simnum flagged hantavirus danger in the Atlantic-cruise outbreak, reporting the Andes strain on the Dutch-flagged MV Hondius and raising international concern. The U.S. CDC has issued a Level 3 emergency response and activated its emergency operations center. The ship, with about 150 people including two Indian nationals who are crew members, departed Argentina and anchored off the Canary Islands, Spain, where passengers disembarked under WHO/Spanish authorities’ protocol. The first fatality aboard the Hondius has been reported. The two Indian nationals are healthy and asymptomatic and were evacuated to the Netherlands for quarantine, with the Indian Embassy in Madrid coordinating with Spanish authorities and monitoring the situation. Public advisories urged minimizing contact with infected rodents, maintaining cleanliness, and practicing good hygiene to reduce infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: 北朝鮮がクルーズ船アウトブレイクのハンタウイルス危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では3つ該当（深刻な影響・予想外・国際的拡大リスク）。複数国にまたがるアウトブレイク、死亡例あり、U.S. CDC Level 3対応。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で該当。国際的関心が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した多数の発生地域（スペイン、米国、オランダ、アルゼンチン、北朝鮮等）は記事サマリーにおけるクルーズ船乗客・乗員の国籍や船籍、避難先として言及されているもので、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。クルーズ船MV Hondius上での発生であり、乗船者にインド国籍の船員2名が含まれているため、Indiaのみを対象国として verified_locations に含める。スペイン・オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Two Indians On Hantavirus-Hit Cruise Ship Are Safe: Embassy | World
article.articleSummary: Two Indian nationals aboard the hantavirus-hit MV Hondius are safe and asymptomatic, according to the Indian Embassy in Madrid. The Dutch-flagged expedition cruise, carrying around 150 people including the two Indians, anchored off Spain’s Canary Islands as a hantavirus outbreak prompted WHO monitoring. The passengers disembarked per WHO and Spanish authority protocols, while the two Indian crew members were evacuated to the Netherlands for quarantine under applicable health safeguards. The embassy says the Indian ambassador is in close contact with Spanish authorities and monitoring the situation. The first plane carrying Spanish evacuees departed from the Canary Islands for Madrid. WHO said on May 4 the incident on the Atlantic voyage was being monitored and supported, with three deaths and multiple suspected infections confirmed on board. The Hondius had departed Ushuaia, Argentina on March 20, aiming to Cape Verde on May 4; vessel is 107.6 m with up to 170 passengers and 57 crew.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染が発生した客船乗船中のインド国籍者2人は安全：大使館
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡3名、複数の感染疑い例）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（複数国籍の乗客、国家間の移送）の3つ以上に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）と流行可能性（閉鎖環境での人-人感染）に該当。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生地はスペイン（カナリア諸島沖）、アルゼンチン（ウスアイア出発地）、インド（乗客国籍）。オランダはハンタウイルス患者の隔離先だが発生地ではない。カーボベルデは目的地であり確認発生地ではない。閉鎖環境での集団発生（船上150名）として公衆衛生上の重大イベント。WHO監視中、複数国の保健当局が関与。

article.articleHeadline: 2 Indians aboard cruise ship with hantavirus cases evacuated to Netherlands - The Economic Times
article.articleSummary: As of 11 May 2026, two Indian crew members on the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius have been evacuated to the Netherlands amid a hantavirus outbreak reported on board. The evacuees are healthy and asymptomatic and are undergoing quarantine under established health protocols. Spanish authorities and WHO experts are coordinating the response to contain the event. Hantavirus is transmitted through rodents, and the incident has resulted in three deaths. The report provides no further details on the infection source or specific onboard exposure, but confirms the ship’s outbreak and international management.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染が報告されたクルーズ船に乗船していたインド人2名がオランダに避難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）。ハンタウイルスアウトブレイク、複数国間の国際的対応、死亡者発生。
triage.notes: クルーズ船MV Hondiusは国際的な移動対象であり、スペイン・オランダなども関与しているが、対象国リストに含まれる該当国はインドのみ（インド人乗組員が当事者）。ハンタウイルスの人-人感染の可能性は低いとされるが、3名の死亡が報告されており重症度が高い。スペイン当局とWHO専門家が対応調整中との記述あり、国際的な保健危機管理の段階にある。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาล เผย ยังไม่พบ 'ไวรัสฮันตา' ระบาดในไทย เฝ้าระวังใกล้ชิด เพิ่มมาตรการคัดกรอง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government says there has not been a Hantavirus outbreak in Thailand; close monitoring and enhanced screening measures.
article.articleSummary: Thailand has not detected a hantavirus outbreak as of May 11, 2026; authorities report low risk but have intensified surveillance following the WHO report linking infections to a cruise ship in the Southern Atlantic Ocean. Hantavirus, carried by rodents such as rats and mice, typically spreads via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent urine or feces in enclosed spaces; human-to-human transmission is rare and limited to certain strains. There is no specific treatment or vaccine; care is supportive. The government directs the Department of Disease Control to heighten screening for travelers from risk areas and coordinate with airlines, ports, and health services to screen those with rodent exposure. The National Communicable Diseases Committee endorsed studying whether hantavirus should be designated a dangerous infectious disease under Thailand's Communicable Diseases Act, 2015, with risk assessment and enhanced response plans. Public cooperation urged to avoid rodent-infested areas, disinfect cleaned spaces, and prevent rodent infestations.

triage.headline_ja: タイ政府、ハンタウイルス感染症のタイでの流行を未検出と発表。厳重な監視と検査措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: タイではハンタウイルスの流行が未検出だが、国家疾病委員会が危険感染症への指定検討を決定し、政府による監視強化と対応計画策定が開始されている。情報が限定的であり、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイでのハンタウイルス流行未検出を報告し、政府が危険感染症への指定検討と監視強化を発表。ハンタウイルス自体は確認されていないが、国家委員会レベルでの対応検討が開始されており、政治的関心が高い。外部支援は不要だが、継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: North Korea flags Hantavirus danger amid cruise ship outbreak
article.articleSummary: On May 10, 2026, North Korea flagged a Hantavirus outbreak on the Dutch-flagged cruise ship MV Hondius in the Atlantic, with three passengers dead from the Andes strain. The ship, carrying about 150 people and departed from Argentina, anchored off the Canary Islands, Spain, where passengers disembarked under WHO and Spanish authorities' protocols; two Indian nationals (crew) were healthy and asymptomatic and evacuated to the Netherlands for quarantine. The U.S. CDC issued a Level 3 emergency and activated its Emergency Operations Center in response. North Korea’s Rodong Simnum warned of potential international risk, echoing its COVID-19-era border controls. Public guidance urged minimizing rodent contact, keeping clean environments, and personal hygiene. Embassy of India reported ongoing monitoring; the two Indian crew members are in quarantine in the Netherlands, with authorities coordinating with Spanish officials.

triage.headline_ja: 北朝鮮、クルーズ船での流行に伴いハンタウイルスの危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の国際的クルーズ船流行事例であり、複数国への拡大リスク、死亡例の報告、US CDCの高度な対応（レベル3緊急事態）によりIHR基準を2つ以上満たし、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題となっている実際のハンタウイルス発生地点はクルーズ船上（オランダ籍）である。対象国リスト内では、インド国籍のクルー2名がネットランドに隔離されているという事実のみが該当する。スペイン領カナリア諸島（乗客下船地）、アルゼンチン（出航地）、オランダ（隔離先）、北朝鮮（警告国）、米国（CDC対応）は対象国外のため除外。本事例はWHO・各国保健当局への国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Outbreak: Two Indian Crew Members From Virus-Hit MV Hondius Safe and Asymptomatic, Says Indian Embassy in Spain | 🌎 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: A hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius (Dutch-flagged expedition cruise) off the Canary Islands, Spain. About 150 people onboard, including two Indian nationals who serve as crew; both are healthy and asymptomatic and have been evacuated to the Netherlands for quarantine under health protocols, per the Indian Embassy in Madrid. The ship anchored off the Canary Islands after departing Ushuaia on March 20, with Cape Verde on its itinerary expected by May 4. The World Health Organization confirmed a hantavirus outbreak aboard the vessel on May 4, reporting three deaths and multiple suspected infections; Spain’s authorities and WHO are monitoring the situation. Passengers disembarked per WHO/Spanish protocols; the first batch of Spanish passengers was evacuated to Madrid from the Canary Islands. The Indian Embassy notes ongoing close coordination with Spanish authorities; the two Indians remain in quarantine in the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症の集団発生：MV Hondius号のインド人乗組員2名は安全で無症状、スペイン駐在インド大使館が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡者3名・複数感染疑い例、国際海上での予想外の集団発生、複数国への拡大リスク、国際貿易・渡航への影響）。国際的な海洋クルーズ船での多国籍乗客・乗組員を含む集団発生であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの検証により、実際のイベント発生地はスペイン（Canary Islands）およびオランダであり、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。インド人乗組員2名が関連していることで対象国インドを verified_locations に含める。ただし、インド人は乗組員であり、イベント自体はスペイン領沖の国際海上で発生している。WHO確認の3死亡、複数感染疑い例、複数国への乗客・乗組員の分散と隔離措置が実施されている点が高リスク。WAHO(WHO欧州地域事務局)対応が主となるが、インドとの外交・公衆衛生協力が必要であり、グローバルな感染症シグナルとして重要。

article.articleHeadline: 被鱼刺扎伤感染"食肉菌"，处理海产品需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fishbone puncture wound infected with flesh-eating bacteria: beware when handling seafood.
article.articleSummary: By May 11, 2026, a 70-year-old woman developed a rapidly progressive wound infection after a fishbone puncture on her left middle finger while handling seafood, later diagnosed as wound-derived Vibrio vulnificus infection at Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital Infectious Diseases Department. Vibrio vulnificus is a halophilic bacterium found in seawater and seafood and poses high risk for the elderly and those with hypertension, diabetes, or liver disease. Early systemic infection causes fever, chills, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea; severe cases can lead to limb necrosis requiring amputation and can be life-threatening. Prevention includes wearing thick rubber gloves when handling seafood and avoiding contact if skin is broken. Immediate wound care steps include squeezing out blood toward the heart, rinsing with running water for 15 minutes (not saline), then disinfecting with iodine or alcohol; avoid home remedies like rice wine or vinegar. Seek prompt medical care if symptoms develop; confirmed infections require antibiotics and debridement, with close inpatient monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 魚の棘による刺し傷が「食肉菌」に感染：海産物の取り扱いに警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: ビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染症の散発症例報告であり、個別症例の医学情報提供が主目的。国際的拡大リスクやIHR基準の複数該当は認められず、フルRRA前の追加情報収集が適切。
triage.notes: 単一の散発症例報告であり、集団発生や流行の兆候なし。重症度は高いが、個別事例の医学教育・啓発資料として発表されている。今後複数症例の報告や集団発生の報告があれば判定を変更する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: How Hantavirus From Rodents Killed 3 Cruise Passengers & Why It Matters To India
article.articleSummary: MV Hondius, off the Canary Islands, Spain, reported eight Hantavirus infections: five confirmed and three deaths among about 150 people from 23 countries. Andes hantavirus can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome or haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, both potentially fatal. Transmission on the cruise ship is thought to be primarily due to close contact in the enclosed setting, though Andes strain is known to have limited human-to-human transmission. Symptoms start flu-like and can escalate to acute respiratory distress or kidney failure; no specific treatment exists. Two Indian crew members were evacuated to the Netherlands and quarantined; embassy in Madrid says they are healthy and asymptomatic. WHO classifies the outbreak as low risk and expects containment; incubation can be several weeks, necessitating long quarantine and contact tracing as authorities coordinate with India's Union Health Ministry, NCDC, IDSP, and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 齧歯動物からのハンタウイルスがクルーズ船乗客3名を殺害 インドへの影響について
triage.triage_reason: スペイン（対象国外）でのハンタウイルス集団感染で重症度が高い（死亡3名）が、IHR基準は2つ未満。ただしインド国籍乗組員の関与とWHOが低リスク判定している点から、追加情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域はスペイン（対象国外）だが、インド国籍乗組員2名がオランダに搬送隔離され、インド保健省・NCDC・IDSPが関与している。verified_locationsはインドのみとした理由：記事の主題はスペインでの発生だが、「インドへの影響」を示唆する見出しであり、インド当局の対応が記載されているため。ただしWHOが低リスク判定していることから、PICKUPではなくWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: 女子养鹦鹉二十天 眼部感染寄生虫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman who kept a parrot for twenty days develops an ocular parasitic infection.
article.articleSummary: In Wuhan, Hubei, a 20-day parrot keeper developed microsporidial keratitis after close contact with a pet parrot. The woman bought a parrot chick on March 16; by April 5 she had red, itchy right eye with a foreign-body sensation, and the left eye soon followed. After three hospitals, May 5 corneal scraping confirmed bilateral microsporidial keratitis, now under targeted treatment with months of follow-up. Microsporidia are tiny parasitic organisms, fungus-like, that can inhabit parrots and transmit to humans via saliva and feces, causing eye infection. This case adds to growing pet bird–associated zoonoses, alongside psittacosis. Public health advice calls for selecting healthy adult birds, avoiding intimate contact, regular deworming, and cage disinfection. China’s Animal Epidemic Prevention Law Article 7 requires vaccination, disinfection, testing, and quarantine duties for breeders, sellers, and owners.

triage.headline_ja: オウムを20日間飼育した女性が眼部寄生虫感染を発症
triage.triage_reason: ペットオウムに関連した動物由来感染症（微胞子虫症）の個例報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクの証拠に乏しい。ただし、新興動物由来感染症の増加傾向の一事例として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は微胞子虫症（Microsporidial keratitis）であり、見出しに記載されたオウム病（Psittacosis）とは異なる。記事内では両疾患がペットオウムに関連した動物由来感染症として併記されているが、実際の患者の診断は微胞子虫症に限定されている。単一事例報告であり、集団発生の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hanoi vigila salud de viajeros ante riesgo del virus Hanta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi monitors travelers' health amid hantavirus risk.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi health authorities tighten hantavirus surveillance at Noi Bai International Airport to counter potential infections amid a global cluster. Urgent Directive No. 666/PB-BTN, dated May 5, 2026, from the Department of Disease Prevention requires Hanoi’s CDC to monitor international epidemiology and propose timely response measures. CDC Hanoi will bolster entry screening to identify suspected or confirmed cases, enforce isolation and control from the outset, and intensify quarantine and transit cargo inspections to detect transmission sources. Rodent surveillance at borders continues, with staff training in protection, sanitation, and outbreak prevention. Hospitals should stock diagnostic reagents and medications and be ready to receive, isolate, and treat patients to reduce severe complications and mortality, reporting cases immediately for epidemiological investigations. Community surveillance for SARI or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome linked to hantavirus is intensified. WHO notes a SARI cluster on a cruise from Argentina to the South Atlantic (Apr 1–May 4, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスのリスクに対するハノイの渡航者健康監視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。アルゼンチンからの南大西洋クルーズにおけるSARI集団発生が報告されており、国際的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはハノイ（ベトナム）の当局による監視強化と、アルゼンチンからの南大西洋クルーズにおけるSARI集団発生の両要素を含む。ベトナムは対象国リストに該当するため included。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていない（記事の主題はベトナムの監視対応）。ハンタウイルス感染症は出血熱を伴うため重症度が高く、国際的な懸念として機能している。

article.articleHeadline: รบ.เฝ้าระวังไวรัสฮันตาย้ำในไทยยังไม่พบระบาด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government monitors hantavirus, reiterating that no outbreak has been detected in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: On 11 May 2026, Thailand reports no hantavirus outbreak; WHO-linked infections from a cruise ship in the South Atlantic have been reported, but domestically there is no outbreak and risk remains low. Hantavirus is carried by rodents such as deer mice and house mice, with human infection mainly via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent urine or droppings in enclosed spaces; human-to-human transmission is rare and limited to certain strains. The government has tasked the Department of Disease Control to intensify surveillance at international entry points and within the country, coordinating with airlines, ports, and agencies; health facilities will increase screening for individuals with rodent exposure. The National Communicable Disease Committee approved studying designating hantavirus as a dangerous disease under the Communicable Diseases Act B.E. 2558, with risk assessments and preparedness plans. Citizens are urged to avoid rodent-infested areas, avoid sweeping or vacuuming dusty spaces, and use disinfectants during cleanup.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、ハンタウイルスを監視。タイではアウトブレイク報告なしと強調
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内ではハンタウイルスの流行が報告されていないが、南大西洋のクルーズ船でWHO関連感染が報告されており、政府が強化監視を決定している状況。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ国内でのハンタウイルス流行がないことを強調しており、現時点での直接的なアウトブレイク報告はない。ただし、南大西洋のクルーズ船での感染報告とタイ政府による強化監視・法律改正検討は、潜在的なリスク認識を示唆している。ハンタウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染が限定的であるため、直近のピックアップ基準を満たさないが、社会的関心と政府対応があるため要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: Keeping rodents in check is crucial to avoiding hantavirus risk, say health experts
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus risk prompts Mumbai authorities to intensify rodent control and sanitation ahead of the monsoon. As of May 11, 2026, public health officials warn about hantavirus infections and other monsoon-related ailments, urging BMC and state agencies to boost sanitation and rodent-control measures. The alert follows a hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship, which travelled from the Netherlands to the Atlantic and docked at the Canary Islands (Granadilla de Abona). More than 180 passengers were stranded for over three weeks; among them were two Indian nationals. Passengers are to remain in isolation for 42 days before returning to their home countries. Evacuation by military buses occurred at the port. The article underscores the global concern and emphasizes rodent-control as a preventive measure for Mumbai during the upcoming monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ：ハンタウイルスのリスクを回避するにはげっ歯類の管理が重要と健康専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の国際的拡大（オランダ→カナリア諸島→インド関連）、異常な流行（クルーズ船での集団感染180名以上）、公衆衛生当局による対応強化が報告されており、IHR基準3項目とWPRO基準複数項目に該当する。インドでの感染懸念とムンバイでの対策強化により、検証対象国での直接的なシグナルである。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはスペイン（カナリア諸島）とオランダが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はムンバイ（インド）でのハンタウイルスリスク警告と対策であり、クルーズ船での流行は海上で発生し、インド国内での感染懸念・当局対応が記事の焦点である。したがってverified_locationsはインドのみとした。クルーズ船の国際的な移動と隔離措置（42日間）は国際的拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Outbreak: Two Indians Aboard Dutch Cruise Ship Evacuated To Netherlands
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius led to evacuation of two Indian crew members to the Netherlands; both are healthy, asymptomatic, and quarantined. The vessel, with about 150 passengers and crew, docked in Spain’s Canary Islands; following WHO and Spanish protocols, disembarkation proceeded. The two Indian nationals were evacuated to the Netherlands per CENEM for quarantine under health safety protocol. WHO and Spanish authorities are coordinating epidemiological assessment, with exterior health confirming all evacuees are asymptomatic. The outbreak has caused three deaths and five confirmed infections among passengers, triggering a 42‑day monitoring period for all exposed individuals. Repatriation flights landed in Madrid and Paris; five French nationals aboard showed symptoms and were isolated for testing. Evacuation flights were planned to Canada, the UK, the Netherlands, Ireland, Turkey, and the United States, with a final flight to Australia; operation expected to conclude Monday. Published 2026-05-11.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症の集団発生: オランダの客船内でインド人乗員2名がオランダに避難
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での国際的な集団発生であり、死亡例3件、確認感染5件、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、複数国への渡航に伴う国際拡大リスク、および42日間の監視期間が必要な高い感染力を示唆している。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の発生地はオランダの客船（MV Hondius）内であり、カナリア諸島（スペイン）で停泊。インド国籍の乗員が関与しており、インドはサマリーで重要な役割を占める。対象国リストではインドのみ該当。スペイン、フランス、オランダなど複数国の関係機関が関与しているが、これらは対象国リスト外。ハンタウイルスは通常、齧歯動物との接触で感染し、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀だが、本事例での感染経路や具体的な症状についての詳細は不明。客船という限定的な環境での発生であるが、複数国への乗客分散により国際的な拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Morte por hantavírus em Minas Gerais é 1º óbito no Brasil em 2026 - Portal N10
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus death in Minas Gerais is Brazil's first death in 2026 - Portal N10.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais confirms Brazil's first hantavirus death in 2026. The victim, a 46-year-old man from Carmo do Paranaíba in the Alto Paranaíba region, had a history of contact with wild rodents in an agricultural area. Symptoms began February 2; six days later, on February 8, he died. Infection was confirmed by Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed). Officials describe the case as isolated, with no links to other records. Hantavirus disease in Brazil typically presents as Hantavirus Cardiopulmonary Syndrome and is transmitted mainly via inhalation of urine, feces, or saliva from infected rodents in rural settings. There is no specific treatment; management is supportive. Preventive measures focus on reducing rodent contact and exposure: secure food, manage waste, keep surroundings clean, ventilate closed spaces, damp-clean before cleaning, and maintain distance between dwellings and fields.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州のハンタウイルス死亡は2026年ブラジル初の死亡例
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症による死亡例として公衆衛生上の懸念があり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、現段階では孤立例との報告のため情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスは致死率の高い人畜共通感染症であり、記事では孤立例と記載されているが、野鼠との接触が感染源とされており、農業地域での職業的曝露リスクが存在。2026年のブラジル初の死亡例として公衆衛生機関による報告があり、政府の関心は確認される。ただし現段階では単一例かつ地域限定的との報告のため、追加例の報告を要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai 6 tuổi nguy kịch vì biến chứng nặng từ thủy đậu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six-year-old boy in critical condition due to severe chickenpox complications.
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old boy in Vietnam's National Hospital for Tropical Diseases is in critical condition due to severe complications from chickenpox (varicella). After about six days of illness, he presented with persistent high fever and a widespread vesicular rash, rapidly progressing to a hemorrhagic, coagulopathic form with multi-site bleeding (nasal, gastrointestinal) and severe pneumonia-triggered respiratory failure. He required non-invasive ventilation, then endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation within hours of admission. Procalcitonin rose above 100, and blood cultures confirmed septicemia due to Streptococcus pneumoniae on a backdrop of varicella. After two days of aggressive antiviral therapy plus high-dose antibiotics, bleeding and coagulopathy began to improve, but fever persisted and the patient remained very ill, with deterioration on day four. The report warns varicella can lead to bacterial superinfection, pneumonia, and shock; emphasizes early care, skin hygiene, and vaccination (starting at 12 months) to prevent such outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで水痘の重篤な合併症により6歳男児が危機的状態に
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重篤事例であり、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク基準は明確でない。しかし水痘の重篤合併症と肺炎球菌による菌血症という臨床的な懸念がある個別事例であり、ベトナムにおける水痘対策・ワクチン接種状況の継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例の重篤事例報告。記事サマリーはワクチン予防の重要性を強調しており、ベトナムにおけるワクチンプログラムの有効性について関心を示唆している。国際的拡大リスクは現段階では低いが、医療体制と予防対策の状況を継続監視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Hantavirus di Surabaya, Dinkes Minta Warga Tetap Tenang dan Jaga Imunitas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for hantavirus in Surabaya; the Health Office asks residents to stay calm and boost their immunity.
article.articleSummary: As of May 11, 2026, Surabaya's Health Office has heightened vigilance for hantavirus, with no confirmed cases reported. The virus is carried by rats and transmitted via rodent urine, saliva, or droppings, and tends to cause sporadic infections rather than mass outbreaks. Early symptoms resemble flu—fever, muscle pains, headaches, and mild respiratory issues—often after exposure in dirty or rodent-prone settings. Surabaya is reinforcing screening at transport hubs with electronic temperature checks at airports, ports, and land terminals. The public is urged to maintain immunity through regular exercise, good nutrition, rest, and mask use in crowded or enclosed spaces. Household hygiene is emphasized: block rodent access, clean up infestation signs, and monitor for infestation. Central authorities await guidance from Kemenkes and WHO on surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: スラバヤでハンタウイルスに警戒、保健局は住民に冷静さと免疫力向上を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（スラバヤ）でハンタウイルスに対する警戒が強化されているが、確認症例がなく、流行の兆候や国際的拡大リスクは現時点で低い。情報が限定的であるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 確認症例がないため重症度リスクは低いが、ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介の散発的感染症として既知である。スラバヤの保健当局による予防的スクリーニング強化と一般向けの警戒呼びかけが報道されており、社会的・政治的関心がある。WHO・Kemenkes（インドネシア保健省）からの指針待機中との記載。今後の症例発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai 6 tuổi nhiễm khuẩn huyết nguy kịch do nốt phỏng nước thủy đậu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six-Year-Old Boy with Life-Threatening Septicemia from Varicella Vesicles
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old boy from Lai Châu, Vietnam, developed life-threatening septicemia due to Streptococcus pneumoniae complicating a varicella (chickenpox) infection. About six days before admission, he had persistent high fever and widespread vesicular rash; initial local care failed to improve his condition. On transfer to the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases, he developed severe respiratory failure requiring noninvasive ventilation, progressing within hours to endotracheal intubation and invasive mechanical ventilation. He also exhibited extensive bleeding from vesicles, epistaxis, gastrointestinal bleeding, and profound coagulopathy with rapid blood loss. Laboratory testing showed marked inflammation, with procalcitonin over 100 ng/mL; blood culture confirmed pneumococcal bacteremia on top of varicella. After two days of aggressive antiviral and high-dose antibiotic therapy, bleeding and some coagulation abnormalities improved, but fever persisted and inflammatory markers rose again by day four, indicating ongoing complexity. Vaccination against varicella at 12 months can reduce risk of such severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘からの生命危機的な敗血症を発症した6歳男児 - ベトナム
triage.triage_reason: 水痘とS. pneumoniaeによる敗血症の重症合併症例の報告。重症度基準は該当するが、単一症例報告であり異常/予想外性と国際的拡大リスク、管理可能性の判断には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例の重症合併症報告（Lai Châuの6歳男児）。ワクチン予防可能疾患の重篤な合併症例だが、集団発生の兆候や管理能力の不足を示唆する情報はなし。継続して類似症例の増加傾向や対応状況を監視することが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: PH airports, seaports tighten border screening vs. hantavirus
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-11, the Philippines tightened border screening at airports and seaports to curb hantavirus entry, with the DOH coordinating with the WHO, Bureau of Quarantine, and the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine to monitor an outbreak linked to the MV Hondius. Hantavirus, a rodent-to-human illness, was detected aboard the vessel traveling from Ushuaia to Cape Verde. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, and muscle aches. Before entry, passengers must file a health declaration via the eGovPH app, listing countries visited and any symptoms. On arrival, infrared thermal scanners and BOQ personnel screen travelers; those from flagged countries or with symptoms are assessed, and ill passengers are transferred to isolation facilities or DOH hospitals, including RITM, for treatment and monitoring. The Philippines is prepared to conduct laboratory testing on 38 Filipino crew members if they return home amid international monitoring; those crew will complete a six-week quarantine in the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンの空港・海港、ハンタウイルス対策で入国スクリーニング強化
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで国際船舶（MV Hondius）でのハンタウイルス検出に対応し、入国スクリーニング強化を実施。複数国（フィリピン、ウシュアイア発出、ケープベルデ）への国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はフィリピンの入国スクリーニング強化対応である。Ushuaia（アルゼンチン）は船舶の出発地、Cape Verde（ケープベルデ）は到着地だが、主要な感染症対応は フィリピンで実施されている。ただし、記事中でオランダでのフィリピン乗組員隔離も言及されているため、国際的な対応が進行中である。対象国リストに該当するのはフィリピンのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ยกระดับคัดกรอง-ประเมินความเสี่ยง 'ไวรัสฮันตา' ยันไทยยังไม่พบการระบาด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enhancing screening and risk assessment for Hantavirus; Thailand says no outbreak has been detected yet.
article.articleSummary: On 11 May 2026, Thailand’s Department of Disease Control said the government is assessing risk and suitability to designate hantavirus as a dangerous communicable disease. Following WHO reports of infections linked to a cruise ship in the South Atlantic, Thailand has not detected an outbreak and regards the general public’s risk as low. Surveillance has been intensified at international border checkpoints and within the national system. Hantavirus is primarily carried by rodents, such as deer mice and house mice; infection typically results from inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent urine or feces in enclosed spaces. Human-to-human transmission is rare and limited to certain strains. Early symptoms resemble influenza, with possible progression to respiratory involvement. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; treatment is supportive. No outbreak detected in Thailand as of 11 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスのスクリーニング・リスク評価を強化 タイは未だ流行を検出していないと発表
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスは潜在的に重篤な感染症であり、WHOが国際的なイベント（クルーズ船関連感染）を報告している。タイは現在のところ流行を検出していないが、サーベイランス強化と危険な感染症への指定検討が進行中であり、情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準は3つ該当（通常2つで通知相当）し、WPRO基準も4つ該当している。ただしタイでの実際の流行は検出されておらず、主にリスク評価と予防的なサーベイランス強化の段階。南大西洋のクルーズ船関連感染という国際的なシグナルソースが存在。記事から対象国リストに含まれる国はタイのみ。

article.articleHeadline: क्रूज पर हंतावायरस के प्रकोप के बीच उत्तर कोरिया ने खतरे की चेतावनी जारी की
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Korea issues warning amid hantavirus outbreak on a cruise
article.articleSummary: Three passengers died from hantavirus aboard a foreign cruise ship in the Atlantic, triggering North Korea to warn of the risk. Rodong Sinmun reported the Dutch-flagged MV Hondius, which departed Argentina, as the outbreak source, with the U.S. CDC issuing Level-3 emergency and activating its incident center. Authorities urged minimizing contact with infected rodents and maintaining hygiene at home and work. Meanwhile, about 150 people aboard Hondius included two Indian nationals who are crew members; they were reported safe and asymptomatic after the ship anchored off Spain’s Canary Islands and will be quarantined in the Netherlands under WHO and Spanish protocols. The Indian Embassy in Madrid is coordinating with authorities. The coverage frames the outbreak as a potential threat to spread and harks back to North Korea’s COVID-19-era responses and mobility restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船のハンタウイルス流行を受けて北朝鮮が警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス流行はWPRO基準で重症度と異常性を満たすが、記事の主要発生地がスペイン・米国・オランダ・アルゼンチンであり、対象国はインドのクルー2名のみ（無症状）。地域的に限定的で情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主要発生地はスペイン・米国・オランダ・アルゼンチン（クルーズ船）。インドはクルー2名が搭乗していたが無症状で実際の発生地ではない。IHR基準4項目該当はフルRRA水準だが、対象国での実質的な感染事例がないため、インドでのリスク評価を注視する必要がある。北朝鮮の警告は政治的影響だが、北朝鮮は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 38 Filipino seafarers from MV Hondius to undergo quarantine in Netherlands
article.articleSummary: 38 Filipino seafarers from MV Hondius will undergo quarantine in the Netherlands ahead of scheduled disembarkation on Tuesday, May 12, 2026. Of the 38, 24 will be flown to the Netherlands for repatriation and 14 will sail to Rotterdam. The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) will coordinate with the DFA to monitor and safeguard welfare under presidential guidance, with quarantine expenses in the Netherlands borne by the ship owner. Health Secretary Ted Herbosa notes hantavirus is not common in the Philippines and that seafarers can safely return home if they remain asymptomatic during quarantine. Hantavirus, carried by wild rodents, transmits via contaminated urine, feces or saliva and can affect the lungs, heart, kidneys and blood vessels; severe cases may be fatal.

triage.headline_ja: オランダからの帰還予定フィリピン人海上労働者38名がハンタウイルス感染症隔離対象に
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の確定例が限定的で、主に隔離予防措置段階の情報であり、現在の公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。ただし国際的な労働力移動に関連した感染症対応であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフィリピン人海上労働者であり、フィリピンが対象国として該当。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。隔離対象者の詳細な感染状況が記載されていないため、実際の感染症発生の規模は不明。予防隔離措置であることから、現段階では重症度・死亡例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Malaria di Belinyu Melonjak, Pemkab Bangka Siapkan Status KLB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria cases in Belinyu surge, Bangka Regency Government prepares outbreak status.
article.articleSummary: Malaria cases surge in Belinyu, Bangka Regency, Indonesia, prompting steps toward declaring a malaria outbreak (KLB). In Belinyu District’s Dusun Bubus, 19 people were confirmed positive after health screening; rapid tests in nearby Bukit Ketok urban village flagged 15 more reactive cases among 295 residents, with lab confirmation pending. If all reactive results are confirmed, total cases could reach 34. Patients are receiving medical care, some in RS Bakti Timah and RS Depati Bahrin, with interventions including fogging and distribution of insecticide-treated nets. Since January–early May 2026, Bangka recorded 19 malaria cases, all concentrated in Belinyu; the district had previously achieved malaria elimination (January–March 2026), making the resurgence a trigger for intensified surveillance and contact tracing. Regent Fery Insani has reviewed screening operations to expedite KLB designation.

triage.headline_ja: ベリンユでマラリア症例が急増、バンカ県政府がアウトブレイク（KLB）ステータスの準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで一度排除されたマラリアの再出現であり、短期間に複数の確定患者と多数の疑い患者が発生（34例の可能性）。公式なアウトブレイク宣言準備中で、地域の異常性が高く、ベクター対策が実施されている状況。
triage.notes: ベリンユ地区で排除済みマラリアが再出現。19名の確定患者、15名の疑い患者（合計34例の可能性）が2026年5月までに報告されている。県知事がKLB（outbreak status）指定を急いでおり、ベクター対策と接触追跡が実施中。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。
